descriptionChirho: Proper noun meaning 'Yahweh is my righteousness'; refers to several persons: (1) the last king of Judah, originally Mattaniah; (2) a false prophet under Ahab; (3) a false prophet in Jeremiah's time; (4) a prince in Jeremiah's time; (5) a priest in Nehemiah's time; (6) possibly a son of Jehoiachin. All are the same name with variant spellings -yahu/-yah.
